title: 西游记
author: 吴承恩
description: 《西游记》是中国古代四大名著之一，成书于明代。全书共一百回，讲述齐天大圣孙悟空因大闹天宫被压于五行山下五百年，后受观音菩萨点化，与猪八戒、沙悟净一同护送大唐高僧玄奘法师西天取经的宏大传奇。师徒四人跋涉十万八千里，历经九九八十一难，一路斩妖除魔，不仅战胜了白骨精、红孩儿、铁扇公主与牛魔王等诸多妖魔，更在心性磨砺中完成了从凡俗到成佛的灵性蜕变。小说融合了儒、释、道三家思想，以奇幻浪漫的想象、幽默诙谐的笔调和深刻的社会隐喻，构筑了一座世界文学史上无可逾越的东方奇幻神魔史诗。
descriptionEn: Journey to the West (Xi You Ji) is one of the Four Great Classical Novels of Chinese literature, attributed to Wu Cheng'en in the Ming Dynasty. Across 100 chapters, it chronicles the sweeping mythical pilgrimage of the Buddhist monk Xuanzang (Tripitaka) and his three extraordinary supernatural disciples—Sun Wukong (The Monkey King), Zhu Bajie (Pigsy), and Sha Wujing (Sandy)—as they journey 108,000 li westward toward India in search of sacred Buddhist sutras. Overcoming eighty-one perilous tribulations, monstrous demons, and moral trials, the epic blends Daoist alchemy, Buddhist philosophy, and satirical folklore into an immortal masterpiece of resilience, enlightenment, and divine humor.

title: 三国演义
author: 罗贯中
description: 《三国演义》是中国古代历史演义小说的巅峰之作，由元末明初罗贯中根据正史《三国志》与民间传说加工而成。全书一百二十回，全景式地展现了从东汉末年黄巾起义爆发，到魏、蜀、吴三国鼎立争霸，直至西晋统一全国的百年波澜壮阔的历史风云。书中塑造了智绝诸葛亮、义绝关羽、奸绝曹操、勇绝张飞与仁德刘备等四百多位栩栩如生的人物形象。从桃园结义、煮酒论英雄、官渡之战，到赤壁之战借东风、七擒孟获、秋风五丈原，小说将军事韬略、政治博弈与人性忠烈展现得淋漓尽致，被誉为“中国传统智慧之百科全书”。
descriptionEn: Romance of the Three Kingdoms is the crowning historical epic of classical Chinese literature, compiled by Luo Guanzhong across 120 monumental chapters. Spanning over a century of turbulence from the decline of the Han dynasty through the rise and fall of the Three Kingdoms (Wei, Shu, and Wu), the saga weaves grand military strategy, statecraft, and human drama. It introduces immortal archetypes such as the brilliant strategist Zhuge Liang, the loyal martial paragon Guan Yu, the ambitious warlord Cao Cao, and the benevolent Liu Bei. From the Oath of the Peach Garden to the fiery Battle of Red Cliffs, it remains an eternal encyclopedia of Eastern strategy, chivalry, and tragic heroism.

title: 红楼梦
author: 曹雪芹
description: 《红楼梦》是中国古代白话小说的至高巅峰与古典文学的集大成者，由清代曹雪芹倾尽毕生心血著成。全书一百二十回，以贾宝玉、林黛玉、薛宝钗的木石前盟与金玉良缘之爱情悲剧为主线，通过荣国府、宁国府四大家族的由盛转衰，全方位、多维度地解剖了封建晚期的社会结构、宗法家族、礼教伦理与人生百态。书中描摹了大观园中的儿女情长、诗社酬唱，与家族败落时的抄家获罪、树倒猢狲散形成鲜明对照。“满纸荒唐言，一把辛酸泪”，小说具有极其深邃的哲学反思与无与伦比的美学价值。
descriptionEn: Dream of the Red Chamber (The Story of the Stone) is revered as the supreme pinnacle of Chinese prose fiction, crafted by Cao Xueqin during the Qing Dynasty. Spanning 120 chapters, it chronicles the poignant love triangle between the spiritual Jia Baoyu, the fragile and poetic Lin Daiyu, and the dutiful Xue Baochai, set against the opulent rise and tragic collapse of the aristocratic Jia clan. Through the miniature paradise of the Grand View Garden and the inexorable decay of aristocratic society, the novel explores profound Buddhist-Daoist themes of illusion, mortal impermanence, familial destiny, and the bittersweet beauty of memory.

title: 孙子兵法
author: 孙武
description: 《孙子兵法》是中国现存最早的兵书，也是世界上最早的军事著作，被誉为“兵学圣典”与“百代兵家之祖”，由春秋时期齐国名将孙武所著。全书共十三篇，立足于深邃的辩证法思想，系统阐述了战争规律、战略谋划、用兵谋略与治军用人之道。从“知己知彼，百战不殆”、“不战而屈人之兵”的至高境界，到“兵者诡道也”、“致人而不致于人”的灵活战术，《孙子兵法》超越了单纯的军事范畴，广泛应用于现代商业竞争、外交博弈与人生处世智慧。
descriptionEn: The Art of War by Sun Tzu is the most influential military and strategic treatise in world history, composed in the Spring and Autumn period. Spanning thirteen profound chapters, it delivers timeless principles of leadership, psychological warfare, resource management, and strategic calculations. Emphasizing that supreme excellence consists of breaking the enemy's resistance without fighting, Sun Tzu's philosophical insights on deception, adaptability, terrain, and knowing oneself and the adversary have profoundly shaped global military thought, business management, and modern strategic philosophy.

title: 道德经
author: 老子
description: 《道德经》（又称《老子》）是先秦道家学派的开山奠基巨著，相传为春秋末期思想家老子所著，全文八十一章五千余言。上篇《道经》探讨天地宇宙的本源与运行规律，提出“道法自然”、“无为而治”的至高哲学；下篇《德经》阐述处世治国之德，倡导“上善若水”、“大巧若拙”、“柔弱胜刚强”的处世智慧。作品文约义丰、辞简理赜，不仅是中华民族精神特质与哲学思维的重要源泉，也是对全人类思想宝库做出卓越贡献的世界级经典。
descriptionEn: The Tao Te Ching (Daodejing) is the foundational text of Daoist philosophy, traditionally attributed to the ancient sage Laozi. Comprising 81 poetic and aphoristic chapters, the text explores the Tao (The Way)—the fundamental, nameless principle behind the cosmos—and De (Virtue)—the natural expression of harmony with the universe. Advocating wu wei (effortless action), supreme humility like water, and simplicity, this seminal work remains one of the most translated and influential philosophical masterpieces in human civilization.

title: 论语
author: 孔子及其弟子
description: 《论语》是儒家学派的经典巨著之一，由孔子弟子及再传弟子记录孔子及其弟子言行而成。全书共二十篇，集中体现了孔子在政治、哲学、教育、伦理及人生修养方面的核心思想。其以“仁”为核心追求，以“礼”为行为规范，倡导“学而时习之”、“温故而知新”的治学态度，以及“己所不欲，勿施于人”、“三人行必有我师焉”的谦和品德。两千多年来，《论语》深刻塑造了中华民族的文化心理、道德伦理与价值追求。
descriptionEn: The Analects of Confucius (Lun Yu) is the core foundational scripture of Confucianism, compiled by disciples to record the teachings, dialogues, and philosophical discourses of Master Kong (Confucius). Across 20 thematic chapters, it articulates ideals of Ren (Benevolence), Li (Ritual Propriety), filial piety, and righteous governance. Promoting life-long learning and moral self-cultivation, The Analects has served for over two millennia as the ethical compass and cultural backbone of East Asian civilization.

title: 庄子
author: 庄周
description: 《庄子》是庄周在Warring States时期创作的Ancient Philosophy代表巨著。逍遥游与庄周梦蝶，以奔放想象探讨心灵绝对自由的道家名作。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "Zhuangzi" is a classic masterpiece composed by Zhuang Zhou during the Warring States era. Imaginative Daoist parables exploring cosmic freedom and spiritual liberation. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Ancient Philosophy, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 孟子
author: 孟轲
description: 《孟子》是孟轲在Warring States时期创作的Ancient Philosophy代表巨著。主张人性本善、民贵君轻的儒家亚圣经典，论辩气势磅礴。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "Mencius" is a classic masterpiece composed by Mencius during the Warring States era. Confucian classic arguing innate human goodness and benevolence in governance. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Ancient Philosophy, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 墨子
author: 墨翟

descriptionEn: "Mozi" is a classic masterpiece composed by Mo Di during the Warring States era. Utilitarian philosopher championing universal love, defensive warfare, and early logic. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Ancient Philosophy, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 韩非子
author: 韩非
description: 《韩非子》是韩非在Warring States时期创作的Ancient Philosophy代表巨著。法家思想集大成之作，将“法、术、势”熔为一炉的帝王御下权谋哲学。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "Han Feizi" is a classic masterpiece composed by Han Fei during the Warring States era. The definitive Legalist masterpiece on political realism, laws, and statecraft. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Ancient Philosophy, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 列子
author: 列御寇
description: 《列子》是列御寇在Warring States时期创作的Ancient Philosophy代表巨著。包含愚公移山、夸父追日、杞人忧天等富有深意的道家寓言集。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "Liezi" is a classic masterpiece composed by Lie Yukou during the Warring States era. Charming Daoist parables including The Foolish Old Man Who Moved Mountains. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Ancient Philosophy, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 三十六计
author: 佚名
description: 《三十六计》是佚名在Ancient China时期创作的Ancient Philosophy代表巨著。瞒天过海、围魏救赵、借刀杀人、金蝉脱壳等三十六个谋略精要。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "The Thirty-Six Stratagems" is a classic masterpiece composed by Anonymous during the Ancient China era. The concise collection of 36 strategic tactics and psychological proverbs. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Ancient Philosophy, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 淮南子
author: 刘安
description: 《淮南子》是刘安在Western Han时期创作的Ancient Philosophy代表巨著。西汉淮南王召集门客编撰的黄老道家百科巨著，融合天地宇宙观与养生之道。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "Huainanzi" is a classic masterpiece composed by Liu An during the Western Han era. Comprehensive Han synthesis of Daoist cosmology, governance, and physical wellness. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Ancient Philosophy, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 鬼谷子
titleEn: Guiguzi: Master of the Ghost Valley
author: 鬼谷子
description: 《鬼谷子》是鬼谷子在Warring States时期创作的Ancient Philosophy代表巨著。纵横家鼻祖纵横捭阖、言语谈判与心理博弈的绝密谋略秘本。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "Guiguzi: Master of the Ghost Valley" is a classic masterpiece composed by Guiguzi during the Warring States era. Ancient strategic manual on persuasion, diplomatic negotiation, and psychological manipulation. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Ancient Philosophy, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 山海经
author: 古籍
description: 《山海经》是古籍在Pre-Qin时期创作的Ancient Philosophy代表巨著。记录上古华夏地理、神话异兽与远古神祇的奇幻百科全书。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "Classic of Mountains and Seas" is a classic masterpiece composed by Ancient Mythology during the Pre-Qin era. The ancient geographical encyclopedia of mythical creatures, gods, and sacred mountains. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Ancient Philosophy, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 史记精选
author: 司马迁
description: 《史记》是中国历史上第一部纪传体通史，由西汉史学家司马迁历经数十年艰辛著成，被鲁迅誉为“史家之绝唱，无韵之离骚”。全书一百三十篇，记载了从上古传说中的黄帝时代至汉武帝太初四年共三千多年的历史。全书涵盖本纪、表、书、世家、列传五种体裁，以宏大的历史视野、严谨的实录精神和生动传神的文学笔触，塑造了项羽、刘邦、陈胜、荆轲、韩信等无数鲜活的历史人物，开创了中国史学与传记文学的崭新纪元。
descriptionEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Shiji) by Sima Qian of the Western Han Dynasty is the monumental foundational text of Chinese historiography and biographical literature. Spanning 130 expansive chapters and over 3,000 years of history from the mythical Yellow Emperor to Emperor Wu of Han, Sima Qian pioneered the biographical-thematic format (jizhuanti). Celebrated by Lu Xun as "the grandest song of historians, a rhymeless Li Sao," it blends rigorous historical truth with sublime literary dramatization.

title: 搜神记
author: 干宝
description: 《搜神记》是干宝在Jin Dynasty时期创作的Supernatural & Folklore代表巨著。魏晋志怪小说的鼻祖，收录嫦娥奔月、董永七仙女、干将莫邪等古代神怪传说。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "In Search of the Sacred" is a classic masterpiece composed by Gan Bao during the Jin Dynasty era. The earliest compilation of ancient Chinese ghost stories, deities, and myths. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Supernatural & Folklore, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 呐喊
author: 鲁迅
description: 《呐喊》是鲁迅在Republic of China时期创作的Modern Chinese代表巨著。包含《狂人日记》《孔乙己》《阿Q正传》等中国现代文学奠基之作。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "Call to Arms" is a classic masterpiece composed by Lu Xun during the Republic of China era. The foundational short story collection of modern Chinese literature by Lu Xun. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Modern Chinese, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 彷徨
author: 鲁迅
description: 《彷徨》是鲁迅在Republic of China时期创作的Modern Chinese代表巨著。包含《祝福》《伤逝》《在酒楼上》等深入剖析旧时代知识分子与女性命运的经典。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "Wandering" is a classic masterpiece composed by Lu Xun during the Republic of China era. Lu Xun’s poignant second collection exploring intellectual crises and traditional constraints. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Modern Chinese, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 朝花夕拾
author: 鲁迅
description: 《朝花夕拾》是鲁迅在Republic of China时期创作的Modern Chinese代表巨著。鲁迅回忆童年百草园、三味书屋与求学恩师藤野先生的温情回忆录。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk" is a classic masterpiece composed by Lu Xun during the Republic of China era. Lyrical autobiographical essays reminiscing childhood gardens and beloved teachers. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Modern Chinese, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 故事新编
author: 鲁迅
description: 《故事新编》是鲁迅在Republic of China时期创作的Modern Chinese代表巨著。鲁迅以幽默讽刺手法重述女娲补天、大禹治水、庄子梦蝶等古代神话。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "Old Tales Retold" is a classic masterpiece composed by Lu Xun during the Republic of China era. Lu Xun reimagines classical Chinese legends with razor-sharp satire and modernity. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Modern Chinese, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 骆驼祥子
author: 老舍
description: 《骆驼祥子》是老舍在Republic of China时期创作的Modern Chinese代表巨著。老北京城里一个纯朴勤劳的人力车夫祥子的奋斗与命运沉浮。 作品融汇了深厚的人文精神与精妙的艺术构思，以生动的叙事与跌宕起伏的情节，深刻展现了时代的变迁与人性的光辉，具有历久弥新的思想魅力与世界文学价值。
descriptionEn: "Rickshaw Boy" is a classic masterpiece composed by Lao She during the Republic of China era. The poignant story of an honest rickshaw puller in early 20th century Beijing. Celebrated worldwide as a defining jewel of Modern Chinese, it delves into timeless human experiences, moral dilemmas, and cultural resonance with extraordinary literary artistry.

title: 邓析子
author: Xi Deng
description: 《邓析子》周代文献，归入先秦哲学类。
descriptionEn: Deng Xizi (邓析子) is a Zhou Dynasty work attributed to Deng Xi. The complete text, in classical Chinese. It belongs to the ancient philosophy tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 公孙龙子
author: active 3rd century B.C. Long Gongsun
description: 《公孙龙子》战国文献，归入先秦哲学类。
descriptionEn: Gongsun Longzi (公孙龙子) is a Warring States work attributed to Gongsun Long. The complete text, in classical Chinese. It belongs to the ancient philosophy tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 人物志
author: active 3rd century Shao Liu
description: 《人物志》三国文献，归入先秦哲学类。
descriptionEn: Study of Human Abilities (人物志) is a Three Kingdoms work attributed to Liu Shao. The complete text, in classical Chinese. It belongs to the ancient philosophy tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 三略

description: 《幼学琼林》旧题程允升所著，明代文献，归入Mengxue Primers类。
descriptionEn: Children's Knowledge Treasury (幼学琼林) is a Ming Dynasty work attributed to Cheng Yunsheng. A children's encyclopedia of the classical world. It belongs to the mengxue primers tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 千家诗
author: 佚名
description: 《千家诗》旧题佚名所著，宋代文献，归入古典诗词类。
descriptionEn: Poems of a Thousand Families (千家诗) is a Song Dynasty work attributed to Anonymous. The poems every literate household once knew by heart. It belongs to the classical poetry tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 文字蒙求
author: 王筠
description: 《文字蒙求》旧题王筠所著，清代文献，归入Mengxue Primers类。
descriptionEn: Learning Characters (文字蒙求) is a Qing Dynasty work attributed to Wang Yun. Character forms explained for the very first reader. It belongs to the mengxue primers tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 大学
author: 曾子
description: 《大学》旧题曾子所著，战国文献，归入先秦哲学类。
descriptionEn: The Great Learning (大学) is a Warring States work attributed to Zengzi. The short text that opens the Confucian curriculum. It belongs to the ancient philosophy tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 中庸
author: 子思
description: 《中庸》旧题子思所著，战国文献，归入先秦哲学类。
descriptionEn: The Doctrine of the Mean (中庸) is a Warring States work attributed to Zisi. On balance, sincerity and the middle way. It belongs to the ancient philosophy tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 诗经
author: 佚名
description: 《诗经》旧题佚名所著，周代文献，归入古典诗词类。
descriptionEn: The Book of Songs (诗经) is a Zhou Dynasty work attributed to Anonymous. China's oldest poetry collection - 305 songs. It belongs to the classical poetry tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 楚辞
author: 屈原等
description: 《楚辞》旧题屈原等所著，战国文献，归入古典诗词类。
descriptionEn: Songs of Chu (楚辞) is a Warring States work attributed to Qu Yuan et al.. Qu Yuan's southern songs, the root of Chinese lyric. It belongs to the classical poetry tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 幽梦影
author: 张潮
description: 《幽梦影》旧题张潮所著，清代文献，归入古典散文类。
descriptionEn: Quiet Dream Shadows (幽梦影) is a Qing Dynasty work attributed to Zhang Chao. A Qing aesthete's reflections, with his friends' replies. It belongs to the classical essays tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 纳兰性德诗集
author: 纳兰性德
description: 《纳兰性德诗集》旧题纳兰性德所著，清代文献，归入古典诗词类。
descriptionEn: The Poems of Nalan Xingde (纳兰性德诗集) is a Qing Dynasty work attributed to Nalan Xingde. The most quoted ci poet of the Qing. It belongs to the classical poetry tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 元曲
author: 关汉卿等
description: 《元曲》旧题关汉卿等所著，元代文献，归入古典诗词类。
descriptionEn: Yuan Opera Songs (元曲) is a Yuan Dynasty work attributed to Guan Hanqing et al.. Arias from the Yuan stage. It belongs to the classical poetry tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 古文观止
titleEn: Guwen Guanzhi: The Finest Classical Prose
author: 吴楚材、吴调侯
description: 《古文观止》旧题吴楚材、吴调侯所著，清代文献，归入Classical Prose类。
descriptionEn: Guwen Guanzhi: The Finest Classical Prose (古文观止) is a Qing Dynasty work attributed to Wu Chucai & Wu Tiaohou. The 1694 anthology that defined classical Chinese prose. It belongs to the classical prose tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 唐诗三百首
author: 蘅塘退士
description: 《唐诗三百首》旧题蘅塘退士所著，清代文献，归入古典诗词类。
descriptionEn: Three Hundred Tang Poems (唐诗三百首) is a Qing Dynasty work attributed to Hengtang Tuishi. The most-read Tang anthology, chosen to be memorised. It belongs to the classical poetry tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 南唐二主词
titleEn: The Ci of the Two Southern Tang Rulers
author: 李璟、李煜
description: 《南唐二主词》旧题李璟、李煜所著，Five Dynasties文献，归入古典诗词类。
descriptionEn: The Ci of the Two Southern Tang Rulers (南唐二主词) is a Five Dynasties work attributed to Li Jing & Li Yu. The lyrics of Li Yu, the last ruler of Southern Tang. It belongs to the classical poetry tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 曹操诗集
author: 曹操
description: 《曹操诗集》旧题曹操所著，三国文献，归入古典诗词类。
descriptionEn: The Poems of Cao Cao (曹操诗集) is a Three Kingdoms work attributed to Cao Cao. The verse of the warlord who founded the kingdom of Wei. It belongs to the classical poetry tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 花间集
author: 温庭筠等
description: 《花间集》旧题温庭筠等所著，Five Dynasties文献，归入古典诗词类。
descriptionEn: Among the Flowers (花间集) is a Five Dynasties work attributed to Wen Tingyun et al.. The first anthology of ci poetry, 500 lyrics in ten juan. It belongs to the classical poetry tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.

title: 全宋词
author: 唐圭璋等编
authorEn: Compiled by Tang Guizhang et al.
description: 《全宋词》旧题唐圭璋等编所著，宋代文献，归入古典诗词类。
descriptionEn: Complete Song Ci (全宋词) is a Song Dynasty work attributed to Compiled by Tang Guizhang et al.. Every surviving ci lyric of the Song dynasty, in full. It belongs to the classical poetry tradition and has been read continuously in China for centuries.
